title: Emerald Saver Account: Complete Guide
summary: This document is a complete guide to the Emerald Saver Account, including its 3.5% APY, the $1,000 minimum balance requirement, and a $5.00 monthly maintenance fee if the minimum isn’t met during the statement period. It explains when interest starts accruing and how to avoid the fee using balance alerts and planned transfers.
